correctness.rationale: For n=1 Ω_1=B(1,1), H1=1. For n≥2 the principal component boundary r(θ)=(2cos nθ)^{1/n} for |θ|<π/(2n). At proposed disk center c=q cos α, compute D=|r e^{iθ}−c|²; derivative sign is c−J(θ), J=r sin(nθ)/sin((n+1)θ). Logarithmic derivative of J has sign n tan θ−tan(nθ)<0 from strictly increasing tan x/x. J(α)=c, α=π/[2(n+1)], hence minimum exactly at θ=±α with distance q sin α. The origin cusp/endpoints are no closer. Thus full open disk lies in component; Geng–Qiu source strip upper bound forbids larger disk. Taylor expansion of closed form gives π/(2n)[1+(log(π/n)−1)/n+O(log²n/n²)]. This is finite-degree model only, no universal extremal claim.
residual_risks: Only Ω_n for z^n−1, not R_n universal polynomial extremal or unique disk center.
